staticText: Private flashcard study tool. Users can create and edit decks, practise with flip, exact-text quiz, or match modes, and bring missed cards ahead of new and Got It cards in the next review. This is a simple adaptive queue, not scheduled spaced repetition or proof of mastery. Starter decks are editable editorial prompts, not an official syllabus, past paper, marking guide, or guarantee of exam coverage. Decks stay in the current tab unless the user explicitly enables on-device storage; raw deck content must not be sent to analytics, cloud sync, query strings, or network services.
